name: Jimmy Alnahar
summary: Jimmy Alnahar is a Diamond District NYC jeweler who runs the verified Instagram @jimmyjewelernyc and owns @alnahar.jewelry. He was referred by Dias and hired Derek to get his suspended Instagram account back. The suspension came from copyright takedowns on his reels. His case can't be fixed through the usual automated method, so it needs manual review and was submitted through portal access on 2026-09-28. As of 2026-10-01 Derek said it should be back 'today or tomorrow max'. He's anxious to get it back because two clients who owe him money can only be reached through his IG DMs.
key_facts: IG handle: @jimmyjewelernyc (verified, about 10.3K followers); also owns @alnahar.jewelry; jewelry/watches, Diamond District NYC, appointment only
Referred by Dias, who had the same kind of case ('exactly how Dias account was')
Price: Dias told him about $3,500 ('35'); he asked if it would be 3500. A competitor quoted his friend $4,000 and he said Derek is cheaper

Account is suspended, not permanently banned, after several copyright takedowns of reels (claims from 'elliemauzy' and 'filmstudiobg'). He won some earlier appeals; for the last takedown he never got an email
Couldn't record the Account Status screen for the intake form because only the appeal page loads
Case is a manual-review type, not one the AI system handles; submitted through portal access on 2026-09-28. Estimate was 2-4 days, then 'today or tomorrow max' on 10/01
Wants to pay in crypto (USDT TRC20 or BTC). Derek accepts either but prefers not TRC20
Promised referrals: says 80-90% of his clients run weed pages that need these services and that they all pay in crypto
WWE star Liv Morgan bought a watch from him and couldn't tag him because his IG was down
Urgent: two clients in his IG DMs owe him money and he has no other way to reach them
services_discussed: Instagram suspended account unban/recovery (copyright strike suspension)
Future referrals for weed-page clients needing IG account services
